Passage: Cryptorchidism is the absence of one or both testes from the scrotum. The word is from the Greek κρυπτός, kryptos, meaning hidden ὄρχις, orchis, meaning testicle. Cryptorchidism may develop after infancy, sometimes as late as young adulthood, but that is exceptional.
